to.description: Recipient session ID, exact name, repo:<name>, or team:<name>. Agents can reply to the CTO but cannot start a conversation with it.

team.description: Team name or ID. Only online team members receive the message.

to_set.description: CTO only: a group of recipients. Team, machine, project or harness is required.

type.description: Request or notification. Send a report that needs no answer as a notification.

as_owner.description: CTO only: send now on the owner's instructions.

order.description: Mark this as an order. Only a lead can give one, to a session below it in its team or repo. agent-net checks the tree; for anyone else the message goes as an ordinary request.

missed.description: Team members with no online session or linked agent.

note.description: Lead routing or recipient waiting information.
